name: flight-recorder
description: Build and run a local Flight Recorder with Docker, connect its MCP tools, and inspect agent traces in VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The recorder connects to local services and can explicitly build and manage a Docker installation.

walkthroughs.title: Set up your local Flight Recorder
walkthroughs.description: Start in an empty local folder: run the service, connect Copilot, record your first task, and inspect its trace.

steps.title: Prepare Docker
steps.description:
Open your empty folder in a trusted local desktop window. Start Docker with Compose v2 or newer and Linux containers. No checkout or host SDKs are needed.
[Docker installation guide](command:flightRecorder.dockerGuide)

steps.title: Build and run the bundled recorder
steps.description:
Choose port 5080 (or a free alternative), Manual start, then Build and Start. Watch the Flight Recorder Output channel and wait for readiness. If already installed, choose Start Existing.
[Set Up Local Recorder](command:flightRecorder.setup)

steps.title: Connect Copilot for recording
steps.description:
Confirm the endpoint, then use MCP: List Servers and normal Copilot Agent mode's tools picker to trust and enable the recorder tools. Skip this if you already configured that endpoint. Connecting does not automatically record tasks.
[Connect to Copilot](command:flightRecorder.connectCopilot)

steps.title: Record and inspect your first task
steps.description:
Copy the first-task prompt from this guide into Copilot Agent mode. Approve actual recorder calls, then select First Flight Recorder task and inspect its events. No custom agent or workspace configuration is required.
[Select Run](command:flightRecorder.openRun)

steps.title: Optionally import native Copilot usage
steps.description:
Opt in to reading a selected local session and bind it to a dedicated recorder run. Measured usage and optional text estimates stay separate. No conversation text is uploaded.
[Collect Local Copilot Usage](command:flightRecorder.collectUsage)

flightRecorder.serverUrl.description: Local recorder origin. Only localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 are accepted. Remote workspaces use VS Code port forwarding.
